name: Domestic super cups staged abroad in the Gulf (Supercopa de España, Supercoppa Italiana, Trophée des Champions, Saudi Super Cup, Egyptian Super Cup)
country: Spain, Italy, France, Saudi Arabia, Egypt (host states: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, UAE, Turkey)
notes: Event-host shape: the entities are super-cup editions, not clubs, so no clubs or kits are recorded; each edition's host facts and sources are on the matching issue and the host deals appear here as organisation-level league-partner entries.

Supercopa de España: the 2027 edition (Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atlético de Madrid, Real Sociedad) moves to Istanbul, 2-6 February 2027, because Saudi Arabia hosts the AFC Asian Cup; Saudi Arabia returns as host at least in 2028 and 2029 (El Español, 17 Sep 2026). Istanbul deal keeps economic terms similar to the Saudi ones, about EUR 40m split among the participants.

Supercoppa Italiana: Saudi Arabia hosted the last three editions (January 2024 to December 2025 finals in Riyadh; the 38th edition, December 2025, was the sixth time in Saudi Arabia). Lega Serie A did not exercise the contract option for 2026-27; the Inter v Lazio edition's venue and date were still undecided as of August 2026 (Football Italia, 11 May 2026; Goal Italia, 24 Aug 2026 - not fetched this run).

Trophée des Champions: the 2025 edition (PSG v Marseille) was played at Jaber Al-Ahmad International Stadium, Kuwait City, on 8 January 2026, organised by the LFP with the Kuwait Football Association. The 2026 edition (RC Lens v PSG) was played in Lens, France, on 16 August 2026 - no Gulf host.

Saudi Super Cup 2026: Kuwait hosts, 19-23 December 2026, Jaber Al-Ahmad International Stadium; teams Al-Nassr, Al-Ahli, Al-Qadsiah, Al-Kholood; organised by the Saudi Arabian Football Federation. Previous edition was in Hong Kong (Al-Ahli beat Al-Nassr 5-3 on penalties).

Egyptian Super Cup: hosted in Abu Dhabi in 2024 and 2025 per the issue's research notes; no primary source found this run and the 2026 host is unconfirmed - see the matching issue for the unsourced list.

Turkish Super Cup: the 2025 edition was played in Turkey in January 2026 per the issue's research notes; after the 2023 Riyadh final was cancelled, no Gulf edition is known for 2026-27 - unsourced this run.
